verdict.rationale: Render's evidence documents defining workflow tasks and triggering runs from code (render-docs-22/23), plus background processes and one-off commands, but these are on-demand or one-off triggers, not recurring schedules. The only recurring behavior is automatic daily disk snapshots, which is an adjacent feature rather than user-scheduled jobs. Nothing in the pack documents cron jobs or scheduled workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
